description:
• Brand introduction:

At Lightwish, our mission is to ignite creativity and empower artists by providing them with exceptional quality and affordable art supplies. We are driven by the belief that art should be accessible to everyone, regardless of their skill level or budget.

With a passion for artistic expression, we strive to offer a wide range of painting and crafting materials that inspire and excite. From vibrant paints and brushes to unique crafting tools, our carefully curated selection is designed to unleash your imagination and bring your artistic vision to life.

We are committed to sourcing the finest materials, ensuring that each product meets the highest standards of quality. By working closely with artists and experts in the field, we continuously strive to improve and innovate, offering you the latest advancements in art supplies.


• Product description: Our main products are our watercolor paints and oil pastels. Not only our own products, but also products from other brands such as Paul Rubens. Meanwhile, our watercolor paper has received wide acclaim from our customers.


• USP (Unique Selling Point): 

Free shipping almost worldwide. All prices include VAT. 30 days money back guarantee and 12 months warranty


• Payment terms: Credit Card (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, JCB), Paypal, Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Bancontact(Belgium), IDEAL(Netherlands), Online Store Gift Cards/ Coupons

Commission, Cookie & Payout RulesCookie Duration:

 1.Referral cookies last for 30 days. If a customer makes a purchase within 30 days of clicking your link, you will receive the commission. (Last-click attribution applies).

2.Holding Period (Locking Period): All orders will be verified manually. All commissions are subject to a 30 days holding period from the date of purchase. 

This period aligns with our 30-day return policy to ensure no refunds, cancellations, or chargebacks occur.

3.Payment Schedule: 

Approved and cleared commissions are paid monthly on the 15th of each month. Due to our manual verification and 30-day holding period, payments are issued on a Net-45 basis (e.g., Commissions earned between June 1st and June 30th will be verified and paid out on August 15th).

Minimum Payout Threshold: 

1.The minimum balance required to trigger a payout is $100 USD.

2.Payment Methods: Payments will be processed via PayPal or available payment methods configured within the UpPromote portal.

3. Promotion Restrictions & Forbidden PracticesTo maintain brand integrity, the following promotion methods are strictly prohibited:PPC Bidding: You are forbidden from bidding on our brand keywords (including brand name variations, misspellings, or "[Brand Name] coupons") on Google Ads, Bing Ads, or other search engines.Coupon Sites: You may not submit your affiliate link or customized coupon codes to public coupon/deal aggregator websites.Self-Referrals: You cannot earn commissions on your own purchases using your affiliate link.Spamming: Posting links via unsolicited bulk emails, social media spam, or automated bots is strictly banned.

Commission Validation & Termination

Commissions will be automatically voided for any orders that are returned, refunded, canceled, or flagged as fraudulent.We reserve the right to review all affiliate traffic. Any violation of these terms will result in immediate disqualification from the program and forfeiture of all unpaid commissions.
